# One line per base slot: its number, its shorthand, its place in the
# Alexandria classification, the block entry it names, and its state.
# Append only: a slot is never renumbered, reused or deleted. A slot whose
# entry is withdrawn stays, marked "retired", so every program that names it
# gets a refusal, never another block. Slots 1..0xFFFF are the base;
# community addenda are never written here.
